desc.zh-CN: DeepSeek-R1 在后训练阶段大规模使用了强化学习技术，在仅有极少标注数据的情况下，极大提升了模型推理能力。在数学、代码、自然语言推理等任务上，性能比肩 OpenAI o1 正式版。
desc.en-US: DeepSeek-R1 extensively utilized reinforcement learning techniques during the post-training phase, significantly enhancing the model's reasoning capabilities with only a minimal amount of annotated data. On tasks involving mathematics, coding, and natural language inference, its performance is on par with the official release of OpenAI's o1.

desc.zh-CN: OpenAI o1 模型系列是专为解决复杂问题设计的，通过更深入的思考过程，在科学、编码和数学等领域表现出色，相较于之前的模型有显著提升。此外，o1 系列还引入了新的安全训练方法，提高了模型遵守安全指南的能力。
desc.en-US: The OpenAI o1 model series is designed to tackle complex problems, demonstrating significant improvements in science, coding, and mathematics through a more thoughtful process compared to previous models. Additionally, the o1 series incorporates a new safety training approach that enhances the model's ability to adhere to safety guidelines.

desc.zh-CN: OpenAI的o3-mini已经针对STEM推理进行了优化。以中等推理努力，o3-mini在数学、编程和科学方面的表现与o1相当，同时响应速度更快。
desc.en-US: OpenAI o3-mini has been optimized for STEM reasoning. o3-mini with medium reasoning effort matches o1’s performance in math, coding, and science, while delivering faster responses.

desc.zh-CN: Gemini 2.0 Pro 模型在编码性能和处理复杂指令方面展现了超越以往任何模型的能力，同时它对世界知识的理解和推理也更加精准深入，所使用版本为 Gemini-2.0-Pro-Exp-02-05
desc.en-US: The Gemini 2.0 Pro model demonstrates superior capabilities in coding performance and handling complex instructions compared to any previous models, with a more accurate and deeper understanding and reasoning of world knowledge. The version being used is Gemini-2.0-Pro-Exp-02-05.

desc.zh-CN: OpenAI o1 模型系列是专为解决复杂问题设计的，通过更深入的思考过程，在科学、编码和数学等领域表现出色，相较于之前的模型有显著提升。此外，o1 系列还引入了新的安全训练方法，提高了模型遵守安全指南的能力。
desc.en-US: The OpenAI o1 model series is designed to tackle complex problems, demonstrating significant improvements in science, coding, and mathematics through a more thoughtful process compared to previous models. Additionally, the o1 series incorporates a new safety training approach that enhances the model's ability to adhere to safety guidelines.

desc.zh-CN: Gemini 2.0 Flash 在 Gemini 1.5 Flash 基础上提升了性能，并引入了多模态输入/输出支持（包括图像、视频、音频和文本），以及实时功能如可操控的文本转语音和原生图像生成，所使用版本为 Gemini-2.0-Flash-001
desc.en-US: Gemini 2.0 Flash builds on the performance of Gemini 1.5 Flash, introducing multimodal input/output support (including images, video, audio, and text), along with real-time functionalities such as steerable text-to-speech and native image generation. The specific version being used is Gemini-2.0-Flash-001.

desc.zh-CN: DeepSeek-V3 多项评测成绩超越了 Qwen2.5-72B 和 Llama-3.1-405B 等其他开源模型，并在性能上和世界顶尖的闭源模型 GPT-4o 以及 Claude-3.5-Sonnet 不分伯仲。
desc.en-US: DeepSeek-V3 has achieved higher evaluation scores than other open-source models such as Qwen2.5-72B and Llama-3.1-405B, and its performance is on par with the world's top closed-source models like GPT-4o and Claude-3.5-Sonnet.

desc.zh-CN: Doubao-1.5-pro模型使用 MoE 架构，并通过训练-推理一体化设计，探索模型性能和推理性能之间的极致平衡，所使用的版本号是doubao-1.5-pro-32k 250115
desc.en-US: The Doubao-1.5-pro model utilizes a MoE (Mixture-of-Experts) architecture and explores the optimal balance between model performance and inference performance through an integrated training-inference design. The specific version being used is named doubao-1.5-pro-32k 250115.

desc.zh-CN: Qwen 2.5 Max 是一个超大规模的 MoE 模型，使用超过 20 万亿 token 的预训练数据及精心设计的后训练方案进行训练
desc.en-US: Qwen 2.5 Max is a large-scale MoE (Mixture-of-Experts) model trained with over 20 trillion tokens of pre-training data and a meticulously designed post-training scheme.

desc.zh-CN: QwQ-32B-Preview 是由 Qwen 团队开发的一个实验性研究模型，专注于提升人工智能的推理能力。
desc.en-US: QwQ-32B-Preview is an experimental research model developed by the Qwen Team, focused on advancing AI reasoning capabilities.

desc.zh-CN: GPT-4o 是 OpenAI 出品的 API 模型，具体使用的版本号为 gpt-4o-2024-11-20
desc.en-US: GPT-4o is an API model produced by OpenAI, with the specific version number being gpt-4o-2024-11-20.

desc.zh-CN: ERNIE-4.0 是百度出品的 API 模型，所使用的版本号是 ERNIE-4.0-Turbo-8K-Latest
desc.en-US: ERNIE-4.0 is an API model produced by Baidu, with the version number being ERNIE-4.0-Turbo-8K-Latest.

desc.zh-CN: 腾讯混元大模型是由腾讯研发的大语言模型，所使用版本为 hunyuan-large-250210
desc.en-US: The Tencent Hunyuan Large Model is a large-scale language model developed by Tencent, and the version used is hunyuan-large-250210.

desc.zh-CN: Step-2-16K 是由阶跃星辰出品的 API 模型，模型版本号为 step-2-16k-exp
desc.en-US: Step-2-16K is an API model produced by Step Star, with the model version number being step-2-16k-exp.

desc.zh-CN: MiniMax-Text-01是一个拥有4560亿参数的模型，结合了闪电注意力、Softmax注意力和专家混合机制（MoE）。它采用先进的并行策略，实现了长达1百万Tokens的训练上下文长度，并能在推理过程中处理多达4百万Tokens
desc.en-US: MiniMax-Text-01 is a 456-billion parameter model combining Lightning Attention, Softmax Attention, and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE). It uses advanced parallel strategies to achieve a training context of 1 million tokens and can handle up to 4 million tokens during inference, showcasing top-tier performance.

desc.zh-CN: GLM-4 是智谱 AI 出品的 API 模型，参数量超过千亿量级。该模型会进行周期性版本迭代
desc.en-US: GLM-4 is an API model from Zhipu AI, with a parameter count exceeding the hundred billion scale. This model undergoes periodic version iterations.

desc.zh-CN: Yi-Lightning 是由零一万物出品的 API 模型，适用于实时交互，高复杂推理场景
desc.en-US: Yi-Lightning is an API model produced by 01.AI, suitable for real-time interaction and high-complexity inference scenarios.

desc.zh-CN: GLM-Zero-Preview具备强大的复杂推理能力，在逻辑推理、数学、编程等领域表现优异。最大上下文长度为16K。
desc.en-US: GLM-Zero-Preview boasts strong complex reasoning capabilities, excelling in fields such as logical reasoning, mathematics, and programming. Its maximum context length is 16K.

desc.zh-CN: 百灵语言大模型是通用语言大模型，已通过生成式人工智能上线备案。基于万亿级Token语料训练而练成，所使用的版本号是Bailing-Pro-1120
desc.en-US: The Bailing large language model is a general-purpose language model that has been registered for deployment through generative artificial intelligence. Trained on a corpus of trillions of tokens, the version in use is Bailing-Pro-1120.

desc.zh-CN: Claude 3.5 Sonnet 在智能方面提升了行业标准，在多种评估中超越了竞争对手的模型和Claude 3 Opus，同时保持了Claude 3 Sonnet的速度和成本优势。
desc.en-US: Claude 3.5 Sonnet raises the industry bar for intelligence, outperforming competitor models and Claude 3 Opus on a wide range of evaluations, with the speed and cost of our Claude 3 Sonnet.

desc.zh-CN: Qwen2.5 模型总体上对各种system prompt更具适应性，增强了角色扮演实现和聊天机器人的条件设置功能。与 Qwen2 类似，Qwen2.5 语言模型支持高达 128K tokens，并能生成最多 8K tokens的内容。它们同样保持了对包括中文、英文、法文、西班牙文、葡萄牙文、德文、意大利文、俄文、日文、韩文、越南文、泰文、阿拉伯文等 29 种以上语言的支持。
desc.en-US: Like Qwen2, the Qwen2.5 language models support up to 128K tokens and can generate up to 8K tokens. They also maintain multilingual support for over 29 languages, including Chinese, English, French, Spanish, Portuguese, German, Italian, Russian, Japanese, Korean, Vietnamese, Thai, Arabic, and more.

desc.zh-CN: Mistral-Large-Instruct-2411 是一个先进的密集型大型语言模型（LLM），拥有1230亿参数，具备最前沿的推理、知识和编码能力。它在 Mistral-Large-Instruct-2407 的基础上进行了改进，增强了长上下文处理、函数调用以及系统提示的功能。
desc.en-US: Mistral-Large-Instruct-2411 is an advanced dense Large Language Model (LLM) of 123B parameters with state-of-the-art reasoning, knowledge and coding capabilities extending Mistral-Large-Instruct-2407 with better Long Context, Function Calling and System Prompt.

desc.zh-CN: 百灵语言大模型是通用语言大模型，已通过生成式人工智能上线备案。基于万亿级Token语料训练而练成，所使用的版本号是Bailing-Lite-1116
desc.en-US: The Bailing large language model is a general-purpose language model that has been registered for deployment through generative artificial intelligence. Trained on a corpus of trillions of tokens, the version in use is Bailing-Lite-1116.

desc.zh-CN: 星火认知大模型是由科大讯飞出品的 API 模型，所使用的版本号是星火 v4.0
desc.en-US: The Spark Cognitive Large Model is an API model produced by iFlytek, with the version number being Spark v4.0.

desc.zh-CN: GPT-4o-mini 是 OpenAI 出品的 API 模型，具体使用的版本号为 gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18
desc.en-US: GPT-4o-mini is an API model produced by OpenAI, with the specific version number being gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18.

desc.zh-CN: Llama 3.1 405B 在通用知识、可控性、数学能力、工具使用及多语言翻译等领域的顶尖能力上可与顶级人工智能模型相媲美。
desc.en-US: Llama 3.1 405B is the first openly available model that rivals the top AI models when it comes to state-of-the-art capabilities in general knowledge, steerability, math, tool use, and multilingual translation.

desc.zh-CN: InternLM3-8B-Instruct是一款高性能、低成本的80亿参数指令模型，专为复杂推理和流畅交互设计，通过深度思考模式和正常响应模式支持高级推理任务和知识密集型应用。
desc.en-US: InternLM3-8B-Instruct is a high-performance, low-cost 8-billion parameter instruction model designed for complex reasoning and smooth interaction, supporting advanced reasoning tasks and knowledge-intensive applications through deep thinking and normal response modes.

desc.zh-CN: Moonshot-v1-32K 是由月之暗面出品的 API 模型，模型版本号为 moonshot-v1-32k
desc.en-US: Moonshot-v1-16K is an API model produced by Moonshot, with the model version number being moonshot-v1-16k.

desc.zh-CN: Llama3.1 支持多语言，拥有高达128K的超长上下文理解能力，具有出色的工具调用能力，并且在整体推理性能上更为出色。
desc.en-US: Llama3.1 are multilingual and have a significantly longer context length of 128K, state-of-the-art tool use, and overall stronger reasoning capabilities.

desc.zh-CN: Qwen2.5 模型总体上对各种system prompt更具适应性，增强了角色扮演实现和聊天机器人的条件设置功能。与 Qwen2 类似，Qwen2.5 语言模型支持高达 128K tokens，并能生成最多 8K tokens的内容。它们同样保持了对包括中文、英文、法文、西班牙文、葡萄牙文、德文、意大利文、俄文、日文、韩文、越南文、泰文、阿拉伯文等 29 种以上语言的支持。
desc.en-US: Like Qwen2, the Qwen2.5 language models support up to 128K tokens and can generate up to 8K tokens. They also maintain multilingual support for over 29 languages, including Chinese, English, French, Spanish, Portuguese, German, Italian, Russian, Japanese, Korean, Vietnamese, Thai, Arabic, and more.

desc.zh-CN: Gemma 是来自谷歌的一系列轻量级、最先进的开源模型家族，这些模型基于创建Gemini模型相同的研究和技术构建而成。
desc.en-US: Gemma is a family of lightweight, state-of-the-art open models from Google, built from the same research and technology used to create the Gemini models.

desc.zh-CN: 拥有220亿参数的 Mistral Small v24.09 为用户提供了一个介于 Mistral NeMo 12B 和 Mistral Large 2 之间的便捷中点，提供了一个可以部署在各种平台和环境中的高性价比解决方案。
desc.en-US: With 22 billion parameters, Mistral Small v24.09 offers customers a convenient mid-point between Mistral NeMo 12B and Mistral Large 2, providing a cost-effective solution that can be deployed across various platforms and environments.

desc.zh-CN: Yi-1.5 系列模型由零一万物出品，是 Yi 的升级版
desc.en-US: Yi-1.5 is an upgraded version of Yi

desc.zh-CN: 360Zhinao2-7B-Chat-4K模型在中文处理和聊天任务上表现出色，特别是在中文基准测试和数学解题方面，并通过先进技术实现了对长文本的有效支持。
desc.en-US: The 360Zhinao2-7B-Chat-4K model excels in Chinese language processing and chat tasks, particularly in Chinese benchmark tests and mathematical problem solving, and effectively supports long text through advanced techniques.

desc.zh-CN: GLM-4-9B 是智谱 AI 推出的最新一代预训练模型 GLM-4 系列中的开源版本。
desc.en-US: GLM-4-9B is the open-source version of the latest generation pre-trained model in the GLM-4 series launched by ZhiPu AI.

desc.zh-CN: Yi-1.5 系列模型由零一万物出品，是 Yi 的升级版
desc.en-US: Yi-1.5 is an upgraded version of Yi

desc.zh-CN: Gemma 是来自谷歌的一系列轻量级、最先进的开源模型家族，这些模型基于创建Gemini模型相同的研究和技术构建而成。
desc.en-US: Gemma is a family of lightweight, state-of-the-art open models from Google, built from the same research and technology used to create the Gemini models.

desc.zh-CN: InternLM2.5是第2.5代浦语模型，InternLM2.5 包含三种模型规格：1.8B、7B 和 20B
desc.en-US: The 2.5 generation of the InternLM model, InternLM2.5, includes models at three scales: 1.8B, 7B and 20B.

desc.zh-CN: Ministral-8B-Instruct-2410 语言模型是一个经过指令微调的模型，其性能显著优于现有类似规模的模型，并且是在Mistral研究许可下发布的。
desc.en-US: The Ministral-8B-Instruct-2410 Language Model is an instruct fine-tuned model significantly outperforming existing models of similar size, released under the Mistral Research License.

desc.zh-CN: Llama3.1 支持多语言，拥有高达128K的超长上下文理解能力，具有出色的工具调用能力，并且在整体推理性能上更为出色。
desc.en-US: Llama3.1 are multilingual and have a significantly longer context length of 128K, state-of-the-art tool use, and overall stronger reasoning capabilities.

desc.zh-CN: Llama 3.2 3B 模型支持 128K 个token的上下文长度，并且在其实用类别中是最先进的，适用于设备上的使用场景，如摘要生成、指令跟随以及改写任务等，可部署在本地运行。
desc.en-US: The Llama 3.2 3B models support context length of 128K tokens and are state-of-the-art in their class for on-device use cases like summarization, instruction following, and rewriting tasks running locally at the edge.

desc.en-US: GLM-Zero-Preview boasts strong complex reasoning capabilities, excelling in fields such as logical reasoning, mathematics, and programming. Its maximum context length is 16K.

desc.zh-CN: 百灵语言大模型是通用语言大模型，已通过生成式人工智能上线备案。基于万亿级Token语料训练而练成，所使用的版本号是Bailing-Pro-1120
desc.en-US: The Bailing large language model is a general-purpose language model that has been registered for deployment through generative artificial intelligence. Trained on a corpus of trillions of tokens, the version in use is Bailing-Pro-1120.

desc.zh-CN: Claude 3.5 Sonnet 在智能方面提升了行业标准，在多种评估中超越了竞争对手的模型和Claude 3 Opus，同时保持了Claude 3 Sonnet的速度和成本优势。
desc.en-US: Claude 3.5 Sonnet raises the industry bar for intelligence, outperforming competitor models and Claude 3 Opus on a wide range of evaluations, with the speed and cost of our Claude 3 Sonnet.

desc.zh-CN: Qwen2.5 模型总体上对各种system prompt更具适应性，增强了角色扮演实现和聊天机器人的条件设置功能。与 Qwen2 类似，Qwen2.5 语言模型支持高达 128K tokens，并能生成最多 8K tokens的内容。它们同样保持了对包括中文、英文、法文、西班牙文、葡萄牙文、德文、意大利文、俄文、日文、韩文、越南文、泰文、阿拉伯文等 29 种以上语言的支持。
desc.en-US: Like Qwen2, the Qwen2.5 language models support up to 128K tokens and can generate up to 8K tokens. They also maintain multilingual support for over 29 languages, including Chinese, English, French, Spanish, Portuguese, German, Italian, Russian, Japanese, Korean, Vietnamese, Thai, Arabic, and more.

desc.zh-CN: Mistral-Large-Instruct-2411 是一个先进的密集型大型语言模型（LLM），拥有1230亿参数，具备最前沿的推理、知识和编码能力。它在 Mistral-Large-Instruct-2407 的基础上进行了改进，增强了长上下文处理、函数调用以及系统提示的功能。
desc.en-US: Mistral-Large-Instruct-2411 is an advanced dense Large Language Model (LLM) of 123B parameters with state-of-the-art reasoning, knowledge and coding capabilities extending Mistral-Large-Instruct-2407 with better Long Context, Function Calling and System Prompt.

desc.zh-CN: 百灵语言大模型是通用语言大模型，已通过生成式人工智能上线备案。基于万亿级Token语料训练而练成，所使用的版本号是Bailing-Lite-1116
desc.en-US: The Bailing large language model is a general-purpose language model that has been registered for deployment through generative artificial intelligence. Trained on a corpus of trillions of tokens, the version in use is Bailing-Lite-1116.

desc.zh-CN: 星火认知大模型是由科大讯飞出品的 API 模型，所使用的版本号是星火 v4.0
desc.en-US: The Spark Cognitive Large Model is an API model produced by iFlytek, with the version number being Spark v4.0.

desc.zh-CN: GPT-4o-mini 是 OpenAI 出品的 API 模型，具体使用的版本号为 gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18
desc.en-US: GPT-4o-mini is an API model produced by OpenAI, with the specific version number being gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18.

desc.zh-CN: Llama 3.1 405B 在通用知识、可控性、数学能力、工具使用及多语言翻译等领域的顶尖能力上可与顶级人工智能模型相媲美。
desc.en-US: Llama 3.1 405B is the first openly available model that rivals the top AI models when it comes to state-of-the-art capabilities in general knowledge, steerability, math, tool use, and multilingual translation.

desc.zh-CN: InternLM3-8B-Instruct是一款高性能、低成本的80亿参数指令模型，专为复杂推理和流畅交互设计，通过深度思考模式和正常响应模式支持高级推理任务和知识密集型应用。
desc.en-US: InternLM3-8B-Instruct is a high-performance, low-cost 8-billion parameter instruction model designed for complex reasoning and smooth interaction, supporting advanced reasoning tasks and knowledge-intensive applications through deep thinking and normal response modes.

desc.zh-CN: Moonshot-v1-32K 是由月之暗面出品的 API 模型，模型版本号为 moonshot-v1-32k
desc.en-US: Moonshot-v1-16K is an API model produced by Moonshot, with the model version number being moonshot-v1-16k.

desc.zh-CN: Llama3.1 支持多语言，拥有高达128K的超长上下文理解能力，具有出色的工具调用能力，并且在整体推理性能上更为出色。
desc.en-US: Llama3.1 are multilingual and have a significantly longer context length of 128K, state-of-the-art tool use, and overall stronger reasoning capabilities.

desc.zh-CN: Qwen2.5 模型总体上对各种system prompt更具适应性，增强了角色扮演实现和聊天机器人的条件设置功能。与 Qwen2 类似，Qwen2.5 语言模型支持高达 128K tokens，并能生成最多 8K tokens的内容。它们同样保持了对包括中文、英文、法文、西班牙文、葡萄牙文、德文、意大利文、俄文、日文、韩文、越南文、泰文、阿拉伯文等 29 种以上语言的支持。
desc.en-US: Like Qwen2, the Qwen2.5 language models support up to 128K tokens and can generate up to 8K tokens. They also maintain multilingual support for over 29 languages, including Chinese, English, French, Spanish, Portuguese, German, Italian, Russian, Japanese, Korean, Vietnamese, Thai, Arabic, and more.

desc.zh-CN: Gemma 是来自谷歌的一系列轻量级、最先进的开源模型家族，这些模型基于创建Gemini模型相同的研究和技术构建而成。
desc.en-US: Gemma is a family of lightweight, state-of-the-art open models from Google, built from the same research and technology used to create the Gemini models.

desc.zh-CN: 拥有220亿参数的 Mistral Small v24.09 为用户提供了一个介于 Mistral NeMo 12B 和 Mistral Large 2 之间的便捷中点，提供了一个可以部署在各种平台和环境中的高性价比解决方案。
desc.en-US: With 22 billion parameters, Mistral Small v24.09 offers customers a convenient mid-point between Mistral NeMo 12B and Mistral Large 2, providing a cost-effective solution that can be deployed across various platforms and environments.

desc.zh-CN: Yi-1.5 系列模型由零一万物出品，是 Yi 的升级版
desc.en-US: Yi-1.5 is an upgraded version of Yi

desc.zh-CN: 360Zhinao2-7B-Chat-4K模型在中文处理和聊天任务上表现出色，特别是在中文基准测试和数学解题方面，并通过先进技术实现了对长文本的有效支持。
desc.en-US: The 360Zhinao2-7B-Chat-4K model excels in Chinese language processing and chat tasks, particularly in Chinese benchmark tests and mathematical problem solving, and effectively supports long text through advanced techniques.

desc.zh-CN: GLM-4-9B 是智谱 AI 推出的最新一代预训练模型 GLM-4 系列中的开源版本。
desc.en-US: GLM-4-9B is the open-source version of the latest generation pre-trained model in the GLM-4 series launched by ZhiPu AI.

desc.zh-CN: Yi-1.5 系列模型由零一万物出品，是 Yi 的升级版
desc.en-US: Yi-1.5 is an upgraded version of Yi

desc.zh-CN: Gemma 是来自谷歌的一系列轻量级、最先进的开源模型家族，这些模型基于创建Gemini模型相同的研究和技术构建而成。
desc.en-US: Gemma is a family of lightweight, state-of-the-art open models from Google, built from the same research and technology used to create the Gemini models.

desc.zh-CN: InternLM2.5是第2.5代浦语模型，InternLM2.5 包含三种模型规格：1.8B、7B 和 20B
desc.en-US: The 2.5 generation of the InternLM model, InternLM2.5, includes models at three scales: 1.8B, 7B and 20B.

desc.zh-CN: Ministral-8B-Instruct-2410 语言模型是一个经过指令微调的模型，其性能显著优于现有类似规模的模型，并且是在Mistral研究许可下发布的。
desc.en-US: The Ministral-8B-Instruct-2410 Language Model is an instruct fine-tuned model significantly outperforming existing models of similar size, released under the Mistral Research License.

desc.zh-CN: Llama3.1 支持多语言，拥有高达128K的超长上下文理解能力，具有出色的工具调用能力，并且在整体推理性能上更为出色。
desc.en-US: Llama3.1 are multilingual and have a significantly longer context length of 128K, state-of-the-art tool use, and overall stronger reasoning capabilities.

desc.zh-CN: Llama 3.2 3B 模型支持 128K 个token的上下文长度，并且在其实用类别中是最先进的，适用于设备上的使用场景，如摘要生成、指令跟随以及改写任务等，可部署在本地运行。
desc.en-US: The Llama 3.2 3B models support context length of 128K tokens and are state-of-the-art in their class for on-device use cases like summarization, instruction following, and rewriting tasks running locally at the edge.
